card.title: Describe a book or film that you have enjoyed recently.
card.lead: Prepare for 60 seconds, then speak for up to 120 seconds.

qs: Describe a book or film that you have enjoyed recently.
What aspects of the book or film made it particularly memorable for you?
Do you think books and films have different strengths as storytelling mediums?
How do you think technology has changed the way people enjoy stories today?
Some people say that classic literature is being replaced by films and television shows. To what extent do you agree?
How might storytelling evolve in the future with new technologies such as virtual reality?
Do you think the stories we consume influence the values and beliefs of society?
